project.name: Tilton on the Hill Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 13 of 16 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Tilton on the Hill qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST PETER and Churchyard cross, St Peter's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Tilton on the Hill: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Tilton on the Hill offers CHURCH OF ST PETER, Churchyard cross, St Peter's churchyard, CHURCHYARD CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST PETER
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST PETER and Churchyard cross, St Peter's churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
